rcPromoted.note: Phase 11 must promote the exact 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate before beta activation.

productionBackupConfigured.note: Provider-level automatic backups must be verified. This gate is inherited from RC_READINESS.json and must not be promoted independently.

restoreDrillVerified.note: A dated non-destructive provider-level restore drill is required. This gate is inherited from RC_READINESS.json and must not be promoted independently.

productionAlertingVerified.evidence: GitHub Actions run 33467741703 (success) + closed synthetic drill issue #115 on 2026-09-01
productionAlertingVerified.note: Inherited from Phase 11: an isolated synthetic readiness failure was detected, escalated through the GitHub incident API and automatically closed without mutating production.

paymentRailVerified.note: At least one intended beta payment rail must be verified with controlled real funds movement. This gate is inherited from RC_READINESS.json and must not be promoted independently.

cartagenaVetCoverageVerified.note: At least three verified and active veterinarians must have Cartagena as their service city. Use the admin-only GET /api/beta/readiness runtime snapshot as redacted count evidence.

clientCohortConfigured.note: The initial invited client cohort must be loaded as SHA-256 Nvet user-id hashes in provider configuration. GET /api/beta/readiness exposes only the configured count and never hashes or raw identifiers.

supportOwnerConfirmed.note: A named operational owner and escalation route must be confirmed before activation.

privacyAndTermsReviewed.note: Beta-facing privacy/terms language and consent path must be reviewed.

rollbackDrillVerified.note: Operations must verify that NVET_BOOKING_ENABLED=false stops new bookings without disabling authentication or history access.
